name: Aurora Hime Higyaku no Makyou: Gaiden Yume no Nakahe...
original_name: オーロラ姫被虐の魔境 外伝 夢の中へ…
source:
This is a side story about Princess Aurora before she decided to get married...

Princess Aurora, fed up with the men at the ball, goes out into the garden.

Waiting for her there were the rough sailors she had seen at the harbor earlier that day...

[Edited from the official website]
translation:
这是奥罗拉公主决定结婚前的一个支线故事……

奥罗拉公主厌倦了舞会上的男人，走到花园里。

那天早些时候她在港口看到的那些粗暴的水手正在等待着她……
